qe: What toxic crystalline compound is released into the human bloodstream when *Plasmodium* merozoites rupture erythrocytes, causing recurring chills and shivering?
qh: जब *Plasmodium* परजीवी मानव लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं को तोड़ते हैं, तो रक्तप्रवाह में कौन सा विषाक्त पदार्थ जारी होता है, जिससे कंपकंपी के साथ बार-बार बुखार आता है?
o: Serotonin alignment fluid
Haemozoin (हीमोजोइन)
Histamine inflammatory ester
Tannic acid chemical derivative
e: Explanation: The breakdown of blood hemoglobin by multiplying blood-stage parasites releases a toxic crystalline pigment known as haemozoin. This compound triggers the periodic chills and high recurring fevers characteristic of malaria.

qe: Which specific trio of fungal genera contains the primary pathogens responsible for causing ringworm infections in humans?
qh: कवक जेनेरा (fungal genera) के किस विशिष्ट तिकड़ी में मनुष्यों में दाद के संक्रमण के लिए जिम्मेदार प्राथमिक रोगजनक शामिल हैं?
o: Plasmodium, Entamoeba, and Ascaris groups
Microsporum, Trichophyton, and Epidermophyton (माइक्रोस्पोरम, ट्राइकोफाइटन एवं एपिडर्मोफाइटन)
Wuchereria, Bacillus, and Salmonella clusters
Rhizopus, Agaricus, and Saccharomyces variants
e: Explanation: Ringworm infections are caused by a group of dermatophyte fungi belonging to three primary genera: *Microsporum*, *Trichophyton*, and *Epidermophyton*.

qe: Why do individuals who are heterozygous ($Hb^A/Hb^S$) for the sickle-cell trait display a high survival rate in hyper-endemic malaria zones?
qh: सिकल-सेल लक्षण के लिए विषमयुग्मजी ($Hb^A/Hb^S$) व्यक्ति मलेरिया-स्थानिक क्षेत्रों में उच्च जीवित रहने की दर क्यों प्रदर्शित करते हैं?
o: Their erythrocytes continuously synthesize active toxic mineral chemical filters

The sickle-shaped distortion of their erythrocytes impairs the survival and propagation of *Plasmodium falciparum*, prompting targeted destruction of infected cells (प्लाज्मोडियम के गुणन में बाधा होना)
Their blood plasma contains permanent three-dimensional cross-linked polyamide networks
The mutation decreases the required concentration of current-carrying ions down to zero
e: Explanation: Individuals heterozygous for the sickle-cell trait ($Hb^A/Hb^S$) display natural resistance against severe malaria. The structural premature distortion of infected sickle-type red blood cells prevents the parasite *Plasmodium falciparum* from completing its growth cycle, leading to the early destruction of infected erythrocytes.

qe: How do tissue-specific pathogens effectively survive and establish infections inside the highly hostile micro-environment of the human stomach?
qh: ऊतक-विशिष्ट रोगजनक (tissue-specific pathogens) मानव पेट के अत्यधिक प्रतिकूल सूक्ष्म वातावरण के भीतर प्रभावी ढंग से कैसे जीवित रहते हैं?
o: They transform their surrounding proteins into volatile open-chain non-polar gases
They undergo adaptational shifts to resist low gastric pH conditions and withstand aggressive digestive enzymes (कम pH और पाचक एंजाइमों के प्रति अनुकूलन)
They compile a permanent rigid coordinate cross-linked outer resin network
They rely completely on free-radical addition kinetics to alter cell membranes
e: Explanation: Pathogens targeting the human digestive tract possess specific biochemical adaptations that protect them from host defenses, allowing them to survive the extreme acidity ($ ext{pH} \sim 1.5-2.0$) of stomach juices and resist proteolytic enzymes.

qe: An immunocompromised patient screens positive during an Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA). Which pairing correctly maps the pathology and target cells destroyed by this virus?
qh: एक प्रतिरक्षाविहीन रोगी का ELISA परीक्षण सकारात्मक आता है। कौन सा युग्म इस वायरस द्वारा नष्ट की गई विकृति और लक्षित कोशिकाओं को सही ढंग से दर्शाता है?
o: Pneumonia destroying alveolar epithelial wall spaces
AIDS caused by HIV, selectively destroying macrophages and Helper T-lymphocytes (एड्स रोग; मैक्रोफेज एवं हेल्पर टी-कोशिकाओं का नष्ट होना)
Amoebiasis targeting the muscular layers of the large intestine
Filariasis disrupting the non-ionic surfactant layers of lower limbs
e: Explanation: A positive ELISA screen combined with severe immunosuppression points to Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS) caused by HIV. The virus infects and destroys host immune cells displaying CD4 surface receptors, primarily targeting macrophages and helper T-lymphocytes ($T_H$ cells).

qe: What primary operational parameter distinguishes B-lymphocytes from T-lymphocytes inside human adaptive defense infrastructure?
qh: मानव अनुकूलन रक्षा बुनियादी ढांचे के भीतर बी-लिम्फोसाइटों (B-lymphocytes) को टी-लिम्फोसाइटों (T-lymphocytes) से कौन सा प्राथमिक परिचालन पैरामीटर अलग करता है?
o: B-cells isolate passing nitrogen atoms from red cell groups entirely

B-cells mature inside the bone marrow and synthesize circulating antibodies, while T-cells mature in the thymus and execute cell-mediated immunity (B-कोशिकाएं एंटीबॉडी बनाती हैं, T-कोशिकाएं कोशिका-माध्यस्थता प्रतिरक्षा प्रदान करती हैं)
B-cells possess an extensive three-dimensional cross-linked phenolic matrix structure
B-cells transform target antigens into volatile open-chain non-polar gases
e: Explanation: B-lymphocytes mature within the bone marrow and drive humoral immunity by secreting specific, circulating antibodies into bodily fluids. T-lymphocytes mature within the thymus gland and drive cell-mediated immunity, directly attacking target cells or assisting B-cells.

qe: What chronic pathological symptom defines the tissue damage caused by filarial roundworm parasites like *Wuchereria bancrofti*?
qh: फाइलेरिया कृमि जैसे *Wuchereria bancrofti* के कारण होने वाले ऊतक क्षति को कौन सा पुराना लक्षण परिभाषित करता है?
o: The rapid structural conversion of lung tissues into amorphous oils
Slowly developing chronic inflammation and swelling of lower limb lymphatic vessels, causing elephantiasis (हाथीपांव या लसीका वाहिकाओं की पुरानी सूजन)
The complete temporary loss of all primary sugar-phosphate backbone lines
Spontaneous free-radical addition transformations inside the stomach lining
e: Explanation: Filarial worms like *Wuchereria bancrofti* live inside the human lymphatic system for years. They block lymph fluid drainage, driving chronic inflammation and connective tissue hypertrophy that leads to the swelling of lower limbs known as elephantiasis.

qe: What serious immunogenic hazard occurs inside human somatic environments if the primary primary thymus gland is surgically removed?
qh: यदि मानव शरीर से प्राथमिक थाइमस ग्रंथि (thymus gland) को शल्य चिकित्सा द्वारा हटा दिया जाए तो कौन सा गंभीर खतरा उत्पन्न होता है?
o: The system initiates the immediate common-ion precipitation of all plasma proteins

The differentiation and maturation of T-lymphocytes halts, severely weakening cell-mediated immunity and making the host vulnerable to infections (T-लिम्फोसाइटों का परिपक्वता रुकना और प्रतिरक्षा कमजोर होना)
The bone marrow shifts into an unbranched biodegradable polyester line framework
The entire somatic network undergoes spontaneous conversion into volatile gases
e: Explanation: The thymus gland is the primary site for T-lymphocyte maturation and selection. Removing it destroys the body's ability to produce mature, antigen-sensitive T-cells, severely compromising cell-mediated immunity and leaving the host vulnerable to opportunistic infections.

qe: Which unique functional pairing correctly lists the physiological and chemical barriers that protect the human gastrointestinal tract from ingested microbial pathogens?
qh: कौन सा अनूठा कार्यात्मक युग्म उन शारीरिक और रासायनिक बाधाओं को सही ढंग से सूचीबद्ध करता है जो मानव पाचन तंत्र को खाए गए रोगजनकों से बचाते हैं?
o: The epidermal layer fields combined directly with cartilage rings
The protective mucus coating of the epithelium lining and the highly acidic gastric juice of the stomach (श्लेष्मा परत और पेट का अत्यधिक अम्लीय हाइड्रोक्लोरिक रस)
The non-ionic linear surfactants balanced across the cellular bilipids
The cross-linked network layers compiled around quaternary nitrogen centers
e: Explanation: The human digestive tract is protected by innate barriers. The mucosal epithelium traps passing microorganisms, while the high acidity ($ ext{pH} \sim 1.5-2.0$) of gastric juices kills most ingested bacteria, establishing a biochemical barrier.

qe: What precise macro length profile describes the total extended linear dimension of genomic DNA packed inside a single diploid human cell?
qh: एक एकल द्विगुणित (diploid) मानव कोशिका के भीतर पैक किए गए जीनोमिक डीएनए के कुल विस्तारित रैखिक आयाम का क्या माप है?
o: 1.36 millimeters exactly
Approximately 2.2 meters (लगभग 2.2 मीटर)
34 nanometers calculated boundary
5386 micrometers metric scale
e: Explanation: Multiplying the total base pairs in a diploid human cell ($6.6 \times 10^9$) by the inter-pair distance ($0.34 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m}$) shows that the total linear length of DNA packed within a single cell nucleus is approximately 2.2 meters.

qe: What total extended linear dimension characterizes the circular genomic DNA payload packed inside a single cell of *Escherichia coli*?
qh: *Escherichia coli* की एक एकल कोशिका के भीतर पैक किए गए गोलाकार जीनोमिक डीएनए पेलोड की कुल विस्तारित रैखिक लंबाई क्या है?
o: 2.2 meters absolute length profile
Approximately 1.36 millimeters (लगभग 1.36 मिलीमीटर)
34 centimeters calculated index
5386 nanometers unbranched grid
e: Explanation: Multiplying the *E. coli* genome size ($4.6 \times 10^6\text{ base pairs}$) by the inter-pair spacing interval ($0.34 \times 10^{-9}\text{ m}$) shows that its circular chromosome has an extended linear length of approximately 1.36 millimeters.

qe: What unique capability allows the Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee (GEAC) to protect public safety across India?
qh: कौन सी अनूठी क्षमता जेनेटिक इंजीनियरिंग अप्रेजल कमेटी (GEAC) को पूरे भारत में सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा की रक्षा करने की अनुमति देती है?
o: It can permanently dissolve industrial polymer assets using acids
It evaluates the biosafety and legal validity of all genetic modification research and GM crop field trials before public release (जीएम अनुसंधान की वैधता और सुरक्षा का मूल्यांकन करना)
It regulates the free-radical polymerization kinetics of commercial plastics
It converts open-chain carbohydrate matrices into volatile non-polar gases
e: Explanation: The GEAC is India's apex regulatory body for biotechnology. It is legally empowered to evaluate the environmental safety, biosafety parameters, and validity of genetic modification research and large-scale field trials before approving any GMO for public or commercial use.

qe: Which specific organic compound is generated when D-glucose undergoes complete chemical reduction using hydrogen iodide ($HI$) under thermal conditions?
qh: जब D-ग्लूकोज थर्मल स्थितियों के तहत हाइड्रोजन आयोडाइड ($HI$) का उपयोग करके पूर्ण रासायनिक अपचयन से गुजरता है तो कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक उत्पन्न होता है?
o: Saccharic acid containing terminal dicarboxylic groups
n-Hexane unbranched straight-chain alkane (n-हेक्सेन)
Gluconic acid monocarboxylic derivative sheet
Pentaacetylated glucose crystal matrix
e: Explanation: Subjecting D-glucose to long-term heating with concentrated hydrogen iodide ($HI$) fully reduces all oxygenated centers along the molecule, converting the carbohydrate into an unbranched six-carbon alkane known as n-hexane.

qe: What happens to the structure of a carbohydrate like starch or cellulose when it undergoes complete biochemical digestion in a living organism?
qh: जब एक जीवित जीव में स्टार्च या सेलुलोज जैसे कार्बोहाइड्रेट का पूर्ण जैव रासायनिक पाचन होता है तो उसकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: It cross-links into an insoluble three-dimensional thermosetting network
It undergoes hydrolytic cleavage of its glycosidic linkages to release single monosaccharide sugar units like glucose (मोनोसैकेराइड इकाइयों में जलअपघटन होना)
It converts into fuming nitric acid vapors inside cellular channels
It forms a volatile uncharged non-polar polyolefin tail grid
e: Explanation: Polysaccharides are broken down through enzyme-catalyzed hydrolysis. This process cleaves the chemical glycosidic links between individual rings, converting the macro-carbohydrate back into single monosaccharide components (such as D-glucose) for cellular respiration.

qe: Which specific organic functional group connection links consecutive monosaccharide units together to build high molecular weight polysaccharides like starch and cellulose?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक कार्यात्मक समूह कनेक्शन लगातार मोनोसेकेराइड कोशिकाओं को एक साथ जोड़कर स्टार्च और सेलुलोज जैसे उच्च आणविक भार वाले पॉलीसेकेराइड का निर्माण करता है?
o: Peptide linkage holding amino residues together
Glycosidic linkage (ग्लाइकोसिडिक बंध)
Phosphodiester bridging matrix channel crossing sugar blocks
Disulfide cross-link sulfur bridge system anchoring lines
e: Explanation: Monosaccharide rings couple via condensation reactions to build complex carbohydrates. The resulting carbon-oxygen-carbon covalent connection linking the rings is termed a glycosidic linkage.

qe: What is the correct mathematical expression used to calculate the degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte from its molar conductivity values?
qh: अमीनो एसिड या इलेक्ट्रोलाइट मानों से कमजोर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट के विघटन की डिग्री ($\alpha$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला सही गणितीय व्यंजक क्या है?
o: $\alpha = \Lambda_m \cdot \Lambda_m^\circ$
$\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$ (विघटन की डिग्री सूत्र)
$\alpha = \frac{\kappa \cdot 1000}{M}$
$\alpha = nF E^\circ_{cell}$
e: Explanation: The degree of dissociation ($\alpha$) of a weak electrolyte at a specific concentration is calculated as the ratio of its molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) to its limiting molar conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$): $\alpha = \frac{\Lambda_m}{\Lambda_m^\circ}$.

qe: What architectural term defines the maximum bounding value of molar conductivity achieved when the concentration of an electrolyte approaches exactly zero?
qh: जब किसी इलेक्ट्रोलाइट की सांद्रता बिल्कुल शून्य के करीब पहुँचती है तो प्राप्त मोलर चालकता के अधिकतम सीमा मान को कौन सा शब्द परिभाषित करता है?
o: Anomeric intermediate potential
Limiting Molar Conductivity (अनंत तनुता पर मोलर चालकता - \Lambda_m^\circ)
Unbranched non-ionic resistance matrix
Cross-linked network conductivity index
e: Explanation: When dilution is carried out to an infinite degree and concentration approaches zero, the molar conductivity reaches a maximum limiting value termed the Limiting Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m^\circ$).

qe: What direct mechanical change occurs to the native protein architecture inside an egg white when it undergoes thermal coagulation upon boiling?
qh: जब एक अंडे की सफेदी को उबालने पर थर्मल जमावट (thermal coagulation) होती है, तो उसके भीतर की प्राकृतिक प्रोटीन संरचना में क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The covalent peptide linkages are broken, returning the protein to single units
The native hydrogen bonds are disrupted, causing structural globules to unfold and helices to uncoil, resulting in a loss of biological activity (विकृतीकरण या डिनेचुरेशन)
The carbon backbone converts into a volatile open-chain gas cloud
The functional domains are reduced to non-ionic starch granules
e: Explanation: Boiling an egg white introduces thermal stress that disrupts non-covalent hydrogen bonds and structural constraints. This causes the folded globular proteins to uncoil and denature, cross-linking randomly into an insoluble white mass.

qe: What descriptive terminology defines the unique architectural feature of the genetic code known as 'degeneracy'?
qh: 'अपभ्रष्टता' (degeneracy) के रूप में जाने जाने वाले आनुवंशिक कोड की अनूठी संरचनात्मक विशेषता को क्या शब्दावली परिभाषित करती है?
o: A single codon can simultaneously code for multiple different amino acids
A single amino acid can be specified and coded by more than one distinct codon (एक से अधिक कोडन द्वारा एक अमीनो अम्ल का कोडिंग)
The codons turn completely volatile and drop down to zero value metrics
The genetic dictionary changes properties dynamically based on solution pressure
e: Explanation: The genetic code is redundant or degenerate. Because there are 61 amino-acid-specifying codons but only 20 standard amino acids, many amino acids are specified by more than one distinct codon (e.g., phenylalanine is targeted by both UUU and UUC).

qe: Which specific initiation codon serves the dual role of initiating translation while coding for the amino acid methionine?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट दीक्षा कोडन (initiation codon) अमीनो एसिड मेथिओनिन के लिए कोडिंग करते हुए अनुवाद शुरू करने की दोहरी भूमिका निभाता है?
o: UUU phenylalanine code
AUG codon (AUG कोडन)
UAA ochre terminator factor
UGA opel stop marker segment
e: Explanation: The triplet codon AUG plays a dual role in molecular genetics: it codes for the essential amino acid methionine and serves as the universal initiation marker that establishes the reading frame for ribosomes.

qe: Which functional pairing correctly lists the classic nonsense or 'stop' codons that terminate polypeptide chain synthesis?
qh: कौन सा कार्यात्मक युग्म क्लासिक नॉनसेंस या 'स्टॉप' कोडन (stop codons) को सही ढंग से सूचीबद्ध करता है जो पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखला संश्लेषण को समाप्त करते हैं?
o: AUG, GUG, and UUU initiation entries
UAA, UAG, and UGA (UAA, UAG एवं UGA स्टॉप कोडन)
GAA, GAG, and GUG alternative blocks
CCA, CCC, and CCG structural segments
e: Explanation: Three codons do not code for any amino acid residues. Named nonsense or stop codons, the triplet arrangements UAA (ochre), UAG (amber), and UGA (opal) signal release factors to terminate translation.

qe: What name is assigned to the regions of an mRNA molecule that are situated before the start codon and after the stop codon, which are essential for translation efficiency?
qh: एक mRNA अणु के उन क्षेत्रों को क्या नाम दिया गया है जो स्टार्ट कोडन से पहले और स्टॉप कोडन के बाद स्थित होते हैं, जो अनुवाद दक्षता के लिए आवश्यक हैं?
o: Exon coding domains
Untranslated Regions / UTRs (अननुवादित क्षेत्र / UTRs)
Cistronic overlapping fields
Polyamide structural link sets
e: Explanation: Messenger RNA molecules contain sequences flanking the coding frame: located before the start codon at the 5'-end and after the stop codon at the 3'-end, these non-translated segments are designated as Untranslated Regions (UTRs) and are vital for translation efficiency.

qe: What direct physical consequence characterizes a point mutation, differentiating it from an extensive frame-shift mutation?
qh: कौन सा प्रत्यक्ष भौतिक परिणाम एक बिंदु उत्परिवर्तन (point mutation) की विशेषता है, जो इसे व्यापक फ्रेम-शिफ्ट उत्परिवर्तन से अलग करता है?
o: The entire macromolecule cross-links into an insoluble solid net layer
A change involving the substitution of a single base pair inside the DNA sequence (एकल क्षारक युग्म में परिवर्तन)
The automatic loss of all nitrogen bases across the targeted cistron
The sudden volatilization of the sugar phosphate framework profile
e: Explanation: A point mutation is a genetic change that involves the substitution of a single nucleotide base pair within a DNA sequence, as seen in sickle-cell anemia, distinct from multi-base insertions or deletions that disrupt the reading frame.

qe: What unique structural molecule acts as the physical adapter that carries specific amino acids to coordinate with matching codons along an mRNA template?
qh: कौन सा अनूठा संरचनात्मक अणु भौतिक एडेप्टर (adapter) के रूप में कार्य करता है जो एक mRNA टेम्पलेट के साथ मिलान कोडन के साथ समन्वय करने के लिए विशिष्ट अमीनो एसिड ले जाता है?
o: Ribosomal structural component matrix
Transfer RNA / tRNA / Adapter RNA (अंतरण आरएनए / tRNA)
Heterogeneous nuclear transcript block
Linear step-growth polyamide string segment
e: Explanation: Transfer RNA (tRNA) serves as an adapter molecule. It contains an anti-codon loop that reads and pairs with complementary codons along the mRNA template and an amino acid acceptor stem that carries the corresponding amino acid residue.

qe: What name is assigned to describe the two-dimensional folded layout model of a transfer RNA (tRNA) molecule?
qh: ट्रांसफर आरएनए (tRNA) अणु के द्वि-आयामी मुड़े हुए लेआउट मॉडल का वर्णन करने के लिए क्या मैक्रो नाम दिया गया है?
o: Inverted L-shape layout framework
Clover-leaf structure (क्लोवर-लीफ / तिपतिया घास की पत्ती जैसी संरचना)
Linear unbranched polysaccharide matrix sheet
Thermosetting cross-linked network model mesh
e: Explanation: In two dimensions, the secondary folding structure of a tRNA molecule folds into loops and arms resembling a clover-leaf blueprint. In three dimensions, it folds into a compact inverted L-shape configuration.

qe: What unique capability allows the Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee (GEAC) to protect public safety across India?
qh: कौन सी अनूठी क्षमता जेनेटिक इंजीनियरिंग अप्रेजल कमेटी (GEAC) को पूरे भारत में सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा की रक्षा करने की अनुमति देती है?
o: It can permanently dissolve industrial polymer assets using acids
It evaluates the biosafety and legal validity of all genetic modification research and GM crop field trials before public release (जीएम अनुसंधान की वैधता और सुरक्षा का मूल्यांकन करना)
It regulates the free-radical polymerization kinetics of commercial plastics
It converts open-chain carbohydrate matrices into volatile non-polar gases
e: Explanation: The GEAC is India's apex regulatory body for biotechnology. It is legally empowered to evaluate the environmental safety, biosafety parameters, and validity of genetic modification research and large-scale field trials before approving any GMO for public or commercial use.

qe: Which specific organic compound functions as the initial monomer building block required to construct a synthetic rubber elastomer like Neoprene?
qh: सिंथेटिक इलास्टोमर नियोप्रीन जैसे सिंथेटिक रबर का निर्माण करने के लिए आवश्यक मुख्य मोनोमर बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक के रूप में कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक अणु कार्य करता है?
o: Isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene)
Chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene) (क्लोरोप्रीन मोनोमर)
Acrylonitrile (prop-2-enonitrile)
Styrene (phenylethylene) vinyl aromatic
e: Explanation: Neoprene is a durable synthetic rubber produced by the linear addition polymerization of chloroprene monomers, chemically designated as 2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene.

qe: What happens to the structure of linear Novolac strands if they are mixed with excess formaldehyde gas and subjected to high thermal curing?
qh: यदि रैखिक नोवोलेक स्ट्रैंड्स को अतिरिक्त फॉर्मलाडेहाइड गैस के साथ मिलाया जाए और उच्च थर्मल क्यूरिंग के अधीन किया जाए तो उनकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: They break down into volatile liquid phenols via hydrolytic cleavage
They develop extensive covalent methylene cross-links, transforming the linear resin into the rigid thermosetting network Bakelite (क्रॉस-लिंक्ड बैकेलाइट नेटवर्क)
They convert into an unbranched biodegradable polyester chain configuration
They form an explicit water-soluble uncharged non-ionic surfactant lattice balanced by sodium
e: Explanation: Novolac is a linear condensation intermediate. Heating Novolac with excess formaldehyde introduces methylene linkages that cross-link the chains into a permanent three-dimensional network, creating the infusible thermosetting polymer Bakelite.

qe: What structural unit remains after a nucleotide monomer loses its terminal esterified phosphate group?
qh: एक न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर जब अपने एस्टरीकृत फॉस्फेट समूह को खो देता है, तो कौन सी संरचनात्मक इकाई शेष बचती है?
o: A volatile aliphatic open-chain non-polar gas matrix
Nucleoside (न्यूक्लिओसाइड)
An active free-radical addition polymer initiator
A cross-linked three-dimensional network panel
e: Explanation: A nucleoside contains only a pentose sugar linked to a nitrogenous base. Adding a phosphate group to its 5'-position transforms it into a full nucleotide.

qe: Which strong covalent bond connects consecutive nucleotide monomers together along a single strand of DNA or RNA?
qh: कौन सा मजबूत सहसंयोजक बंध डीएनए या आरएनए के एक एकल धागे (single strand) के साथ लगातार न्यूक्लियोटाइड मोनोमर्स को एक साथ जोड़ता है?
o: N-glycosidic link bridging rings together
3'-5' phosphodiester linkage (3'-5' फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध)
Amide linkage systematically identical to a biological peptide bond
Sulfur disulfide cross-link bridge system anchoring paths
e: Explanation: Nucleotides fold sequentially into polymers via 3'-5' phosphodiester linkages. This covalent bridge connects the 3'-hydroxyl group of one pentose sugar to the 5'-phosphate group of the next nucleotide.

qe: What molecular architectural arrangement details the relative directionality of the two complementary strands inside a DNA double helix model?
qh: कौन सा आणविक संरचनात्मक विन्यास डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स मॉडल के भीतर दो पूरक धागों की सापेक्ष दिशात्मकता (relative directionality) का विवरण देता है?
o: They run parallel in the exact same 5' to 3' spatial direction
They exhibit anti-parallel polarity, where one strand runs 5' to 3' and the other runs 3' to 5' (प्रति-समानांतर ध्रुवता / anti-parallel)
They are arranged as separate open-chain unlinked carbohydrate blocks
They cross-link randomly into a single infusible thermosetting net plastic
e: Explanation: The twin strands of a DNA double helix run anti-parallel to one another. One strand is oriented in the 5' to 3' direction, while its complementary counter-strand features a reverse 3' to 5' alignment.

qe: Which specific inter-chain bond stabilizes base pairing across the complementary strands of a DNA double helix?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट अंतर-श्रृंखला बंध डीएनए डबल हेलिक्स के पूरक धागों में क्षारक युग्मन (base pairing) को स्थिर करता है?
o: Strong phosphodiester covalent bridges
Hydrogen bonds established between complementary purines and pyrimidines (हाइड्रोजन बंध)
Covalent peptide linkages identical to those in globular proteins
Quaternary ammonium halide coordinate link systems
e: Explanation: Base pairing between anti-parallel strands is stabilized by hydrogen bonds between complementary purine and pyrimidine bases (A pairs with T via two bonds; G pairs with C via three bonds).

qe: How many hydrogen bonds form the complementary pairing between adenine and thymine bases inside a double-stranded DNA block?
qh: डबल-स्ट्रैंडेड डीएनए ब्लॉक के भीतर एडेनीन और थायमीन बेस के बीच पूरक युग्मन (complementary pairing) कितने हाइड्रोजन बंध बनाते हैं?
o: Three hydrogen bonds configuration
Two hydrogen bonds (दो हाइड्रोजन बंध)
A single irreversible covalent bridge
Four quaternary coordinate networks
e: Explanation: Adenine couples specifically to thymine across anti-parallel strands through exactly two stable hydrogen bonds ($A = T$).

qe: What quantitative count of hydrogen bonds stabilizes the specific pairing interface between guanine and cytosine bases in DNA?
qh: डीएनए में ग्वानीन और साइटोसिन बेस के बीच विशिष्ट युग्मन इंटरफ़ेस को हाइड्रोजन बंधों की कौन सी मात्रात्मक संख्या स्थिर करती है?
o: Two hydrogen bonds configuration
Three hydrogen bonds (तीन हाइड्रोजन बंध)
One extensive covalent bridge
Zero net thermodynamic bonds
e: Explanation: Guanine coordinates to cytosine along complementary strands via three hydrogen bonds ($G \equiv C$), making GC-rich regions thermodynamically robust.

qe: What is the physical pitch dimension of a single complete turn of a classic B-DNA double helix under standard structural configurations?
qh: मानक संरचनात्मक विन्यासों के तहत क्लासिक B-DNA डबल हेलिक्स के एक एकल पूर्ण मोड़ का भौतिक पिच आयाम (pitch dimension) क्या है?
o: 0.34 nanometers absolute width
3.4 nanometers (3.4 नैनोमीटर)
34 nanometers extensive length
2.2 meters absolute macro profile
e: Explanation: In a standard B-DNA model, one full helical turn (pitch) spans a spatial length of 3.4 nanometers ($34\text{ \AA}$) along the axis.

qe: What is the structural spacing interval calculated between consecutive base pairs along the vertical axis of a Scholar double helix?
qh: मानक B-DNA डबल हेलिक्स के ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष के साथ लगातार क्षारक युग्मों के बीच की दूरी (structural spacing) क्या है?
o: 3.4 nanometers total length
0.34 nanometers (0.34 नैनोमीटर)
20 nanometers structural area width
4.6 nanometers calculated index
e: Explanation: Since a single helical turn has a pitch of 3.4 nm and accommodates exactly ten base pairs, the calculated spacing interval between consecutive base pairs is $3.4/10 = 0.34\text{ nm}$ ($3.4\text{ \AA}$).

qe: What core mathematical formula used to calculate the Molar Conductivity ($\Lambda_m$) of an amino solution from specific values?
qh: मानक प्रयोगशाला इकाइयों में समाधान की विशिष्ट चालकता ($\kappa$) और मोलरिटी ($M$) से उसकी मोलर चालकता ($\Lambda_m$) की गणना करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाने वाला मुख्य गणितीय सूत्र क्या है?
o: $\Lambda_m = \frac{M \cdot \kappa}{1000}$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$ (मोलर चालकता सूत्र)
$\Lambda_m = \kappa \cdot G^*$
$\Lambda_m = \frac{\kappa \cdot R}{M}$
e: Explanation: When conductivity $\kappa$ is measured in $\text{S}\cdot\text{cm}^{-1}$ and concentration $M$ is in $\text{mol/L}$, the molar conductivity is calculated using the formula: $\Lambda_m = \frac{1000 \cdot \kappa}{M}$.

qe: The single-stranded backbones of DNA and RNA molecules are constructed by linking successive nucleotides via which strong covalent bonds?
qh: DNA और RNA अणुओं की एकल-स्ट्रैंडेड रीढ़ क्रमिक न्यूक्लियोटाइड को किस मजबूत सहसंयोजक बंध द्वारा जोड़कर बनाई जाती है?
o: Glycosidic connections bridging sugar rings together
Phosphodiester linkages (फॉस्फोडिएस्टर बंध / लिंक)
Methylene amide coordinate connection networks across strands
Disulfide cross-link bridges pulling hydrocarbon chain links
e: Explanation: The backbones of DNA and RNA are compiled by connecting successive nucleotides via strong covalent phosphodiester bonds that link the C5' position of one pentose ring to the C3' position of the next.

qe: Which specific organic compound functions as the initial monomer building block required to construct the natural rubber elastomer chain?
qh: कौन सा विशिष्ट कार्बनिक अणु प्राकृतिक रबर इलास्टोमर श्रृंखला के निर्माण के लिए आवश्यक बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक के रूप में कार्य करता है?
o: Chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene)
Isoprene (2-methylbuta-1,3-diene) (आइसोप्रीन)
Acrylonitrile (prop-2-enonitrile)
Styrene (phenylethylene) vinyl aromatic
e: Explanation: Natural rubber is a homopolymer of isoprene. Under systematic IUPAC rules, isoprene is designated as 2-methylbuta-1,3-diene.

qe: What direct mechanical change occurs to the native protein architecture inside an egg white when it undergoes thermal coagulation upon boiling?
qh: जब एक अंडे की सफेदी को उबालने पर थर्मल जमावट (thermal coagulation) होती है, तो उसके भीतर की प्राकृतिक प्रोटीन संरचना में क्या सीधा यांत्रिक परिवर्तन होता है?
o: The covalent peptide linkages are broken, returning the protein to single units
The native hydrogen bonds are disrupted, causing structural globules to unfold and helices to uncoil, resulting in a loss of biological activity (विकृतीकरण या डिनेचुरेशन)
The carbon backbone converts into a volatile open-chain gas cloud
The functional domains are reduced to non-ionic starch granules
e: Explanation: Boiling an egg white introduces thermal stress that disrupts non-covalent hydrogen bonds and structural constraints. This causes the folded globular proteins to uncoil and denature, cross-linking randomly into an insoluble white mass.
